title: Sauron Speaks Out Following the Shutdown of the One Ring
subtitle: "If it was so precious, why did they throw it into the fire?"
body_html:
Sauron holds a press conference addressing the Middle-earth shutdown after the wanton destruction of the One Ring.

Sauron, approaching the podium, “Everynight Orcs of Middle Earth have been thrown into chaos.”

Reporter, interrupting: “Aren’t Orcs agents of chaos?”

Sauron: “Everynight Orcs of Middle-earth have been thrown into FURTHER chaos by this reckless shutdown of the entire Rings of Power system. Across Middle-earth, from privileged areas like the Shire and Rivendell, to the lower-income regions like Mordor, we have relied on rings of power—united by our core One Ring technology—to solve problems. Thanks to the intransigence of small people, literally and figuratively, we are now facing a shutdown of our whole system.”

Reporter: “I’m sorry, does this have something to do with the eruptions rising from Mount Doom?”

Sauron: “I am afraid it does. I’ll summarize the events of the past day. It has come to our attention that the One Ring was, against all good sense, and through what appears to be a complex and well-planned act of sabotage, secreted past our guardians and taken to the Mountain of Fire. A suicide-saboteur then grabbed the ring, and with it, destroyed both himself and the One Ring in the fire.”

Reporter: “We also have had a visual confirmation that Minis Ithil and the Great Eye have crumbled to the ground?”

Sauron: “I regret to inform you that our Nine Riders have also confirmed there has been structural damage to both. However, we believe your question is misleading, and is what we’d call “misleading news.”

Other Reporter: “We have heard the King has returned to Gondor?”

Sauron: “These unconfirmed rumors are just that. Look, not every lost wanderer you see is really the descendant of a prior king. Gondor has stewards, next question.”

Yet Other Reporter: “What can you tell us about he status of magic in Middle-earth?”

Sauron: “Hobbits are holding our Middle-earth hostage unless their extravagant wish list of demands is met. Their shutdown will leave each ringbearer unpowered, including all 7 dwarf lords, nine elderly men, now doomed to die, and even hobble the three elf-lords, putting vital mithril-delving and even tree-care programs for Ents at risk, and jeopardizing flood insurance for millions of Isengardians during the fallout from the rainy season in and around Helm’s Deep’s failing dam.

Meanwhile, Modor’s Nazgul council passed a clean, simple One Ring extension to ensure stability for our seniors, veterans, and orcish troops across the land. I urge my colleagues in the Gondor and Rohan to abandon their ‘obstruction at all costs’ politics and pass this continuing resolution so our mystical services can continue operating without interruption,” finished Sauron, the Dark Lord of Mordor.

For more LOTR satire, feel free to read along here. I promise, you’ve never felt like legal and compliance issues of Middle-earth were more relevant than right now.
